Dance Dance Revolution GB - Disney Mix.name: Dance Dance Revolution GB Disney Mix
Dance Dance Revolution GB - Disney Mix.summary:
Dance Dance Revolution GB Disney Mix is a rhythm game for the Game Boy Color. 
This was the third and last console game for DDR with Disney and the last game released on Game Boy.

Medarot 4 - Kabuto Version.name: Medarot 4: Kabuto Version
Medarot 4 - Kabuto Version.summary:
Medarot 4 was released in 2001 for the Game Boy Color. Like its predecessors, it was released in two versions: Kabuto Version and Kuwagata Version.

The game follows Ikki Tenryou and his friends in the town of Omikuji. A new teacher by the name of Ryuuko Yamikumo gets hired at Ikki's school and confiscates all of the class' Medarotches and deletes everyone's data, forcing them to start over in order to train them. Meanwhile, there are rumors of a group called the "Four Kings" wreaking havoc in Omikuji. Medarot 4 incorporates many of the gameplay changes made in Medarot 3.

Rampage 2 - Universal Tour.name: Rampage 2: Universal Tour
Rampage 2 - Universal Tour.summary: Players choose one of the three original monsters to rescue. The player then uses the characters in the part of the world where the rescue is held. They work as a collective to break buildings, eat people, and destroy cars and this creates competition among players. When a player (literally) unlocks George, Lizzie, or Ralph, then they become playable characters. Once all the monsters are rescued, aliens begin to invade the earth, leaving the monsters the only ones who can save the planet they just helped partially destroy. After fending off the invasion on Earth, the monsters rescue Myukus (a cyclops-like alien) from Area 51 before chasing the aliens through space, destroying the aliens' bases throughout the Solar System and eventually rampaging through their homeworld.

Sonic Adventure 7.name: Sonic Adventure 7
Sonic Adventure 7.summary: Sonic Adventure 7 is an unlicensed 2D platformer based on Sonic Adventure for the Game Boy Color released by Makon Soft Studios in 1999.
